title: StackWise stacks
content:
# StackWise stacks

HQ access switches are Catalyst 9300 stacks; the South branch has a two-member Catalyst 9200 stack. Member counts are in [[Switch inventory]].

## Check a stack

```
show switch
show switch stack-ports summary
```

All members should show **Ready**, and every stack port should be **OK**.

## Member numbers and priorities

| Member | Priority | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 15 | Active |
| 2 | 14 | Standby |
| 3 and above | 1 (default) | Member |

```
switch 1 priority 15
switch 2 priority 14
```

To give a member a different number (takes effect after it reloads):

```
switch 3 renumber 2
```

## Add a member

1. Make sure the new switch runs the same IOS XE release, or enable automatic upgrade on the stack: `software auto-upgrade enable`.
2. Power off the new switch and connect the stack cables so the stack stays a closed ring.
3. Power it on and wait for it to join; check with `show switch`.
4. Apply port configuration from [[Access and trunk ports]].

## Replace a failed member

Pre-provision the slot so the configuration is kept for the replacement:

```
switch 2 provision <SWITCH-TYPE>
```

Then install the replacement with the same member number and check `show switch`.
